properties.name: cryptobench:schema-notes
properties.value: This file is CryptoBench's frozen reference inventory. Each entry under components[] represents one manually verified cryptographic asset. Two project-local fields are added inside each component's properties array beyond standard CBOM fields: cryptobench:category (one of key-establishment, digital-signature, hashing, protocol-transport-configuration) and cryptobench:observability (one of source-visible, endpoint-visible, both). This file is built by two independent manual review passes and is frozen (read-only) once both passes agree. It is never written to by a discovery tool.

properties.name: cryptobench:freeze-status
properties.value: NOT YET FROZEN - zero components populated as of Implementation Sprint I
